correctness.rationale: The edge-row difference is exactly (alpha-beta)(f(u)-f(v))+beta(sum_V f-sum_U f). For n>=6 a fixed-point-free outsider permutation matches U to V by edges and a range-one potential attains the total absolute signed mass. For n=5 the induced (x,y) polygon |x|<=1, |y|<=4-|x| is sharp at every corner by explicit extendable Lipschitz assignments. A^2=(n-3)I-(n-4)A+binom(n-3,2)J gives precisely the two nonconstant heat modes; substitution produces both exact formulas. Positive C>D with C-D=1 makes the logarithmic decay derivative strictly positive; the Petersen Taylor coefficient is -5. Executed exact and LP checks support but do not prove the infinite claims.
